title: Open Editor book manifest, version 0
description: A book: its title, its authors and its chapters in reading order. Each chapter's text is in its own file (see chapter.schema.json). A draft: version 0 may change without a migration.

authors.description: In the order to print them. May be empty.

language.description: A BCP 47 language tag, such as en or pt-BR.

chapters.description: The chapters, in reading order. Moving a chapter changes this list and nothing else. No id and no file may appear twice; a JSON Schema cannot say that, the validator in the package checks it.

id.description: Stable. The chapter document carries the same id.

file.description: The chapter document, as a path next to the manifest.

removed.description: Chapters that were deleted. Their ids are never used again, so a comment or reference to one resolves to "removed".

id.description: 3 to 64 of a-z, 0-9, - and _, starting with a letter or digit. Never changed, never used again.

path.description: Parts joined by /. No leading /, no backslash, no scheme, and no part that is empty, . or ..
